rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user before acting, performed order and account modifications (item swap and address change) without prior user confirmation, and may have acted on orders without verifying they belong to the user. It also did not present or verify the current address/order addresses before changing them, nor confirm the specific replacement item as the “easiest with fewest pieces.” Finally, it provided no clear final summary or confirmation. These violate the stated policy, so the request was not completed in line with requirements.
